question: What conduct should a practitioner adopt after gaining mental evenness through practice?
premises: Practice leads to an even mind.
Village dharma is presented as something to leave behind.
The verse gives an injunctive instruction.
inference: Through practice one should become even-minded and abandon village dharma.
uncertainties: grāma-dharma may refer to conventional social or household duties.
plain_english: Through practice, becoming even-minded, one should abandon the ways of village life.
